subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) in the following series to continue the pattern?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f430276cfbe499e88d4f94bcd7a412a576adccbe85e131c81f5faf6aa18c90a7.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ec4aec7b8e26c2952fa88b5c1c7ab9aa8c43807c26ea99f8cdfdbf404995331.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From figure 1 to 2 and figure 3 to 4:

Top-right corner, top-left corner, left-middle and right-middle element (all 4 elements) are interchanging their position in an anticlockwise direction.

Top-middle both element are interchanging and bottom-middle and middle element are interchanging their position with each other.

From figure 2 to 3 and figure 4 to 5:

All 3 horizontally middle symbols are shifting their position in clockwise direction.

All top 4 symbols are shifting their position in an anticlockwise direction.

Bottom-middle symbol is replaced by a new symbol.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9e9448522243a348d89183bbddfed58b154d21b781e3bf2b3c2fa67a058009d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ef665acaef3b8a7f97f55754c72f2be9efca4358a8e7cdb2e4e3164309a0d88.png] Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
